import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class TaskC {
    public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        
        int[][] coords = new int[n + 1][5];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                coords[i][j] = in.nextInt();
            }
        }
        
        List<Integer> goodPoints = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            boolean isGood = true;
            
            for (int j = 1; j <= n && isGood; j++) {
                if (j == i) continue;
                
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= n && isGood; k++) {
                    if (k == i) continue;
                    
                    long[] v1 = new long[5];
                    long[] v2 = new long[5];
                    for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                        v1[d] = (long)coords[j][d] - coords[i][d];
                        v2[d] = (long)coords[k][d] - coords[i][d];
                    }
                    
                    long dot = 0;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                        dot += v1[d] * v2[d];
                    }
                    
                    if (dot > 0) {
                        isGood = false;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (isGood) {
                goodPoints.add(i);
            }
        }
        
        out.println(goodPoints.size());
        for (int idx : goodPoints) {
            out.println(idx);
        }
    }
}
